summary: Nuran Wireless Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its voluntary delisting from the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), effective after close of business on September 4, 2026, subject to CSE approval. The company will retain its NASDAQ listing under ticker NUR, citing operational needs, low CSE trading volumes, and dual-listing costs. Simultaneously, board member Navindran Naidoo resigned immediately due to potential conflicts. No financial terms, premiums, or advisors were disclosed. Watch for CSE approval and any liquidity impact on NASDAQ as the sole trading venue.
